description: This file defines the ZipStream2 class, which provides a static method for creating a new ZipStream object with specific options, primarily to facilitate ZIP archive creation with stream output.

classes.name: ZipStream2
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to instantiate ZipStream objects with predefined options for ZIP creation.

methods.name: newZipStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ZipStream object with ZIP64 disabled and output stream set to the provided file handle.
